routes.title: Disclosure / source-material pressure
why_it_helps: May assist as conditional prosecution-pressure if MG6 or schedules show outstanding CCTV/CAD/999/MG11 or unused material.
Creates pressure if proved only once the listed source material is served and reviewed.
what_hurts_us: Outstanding items are chased but return consistent with the Crown case.
Thin bundle with no published disclosure schedule to anchor a chase.
collapse_risks: Assumed position may conflict with interview or served evidence.
Outstanding disclosure is served and supports the Crown route.
MG6 itself lists the material as served and consistent.
Chase returns master CCTV that undermines the defence timing/ID point.
next_moves: Ask for full MG11/source material and unused schedule detail.
Prepare hearing line on outstanding disclosure; set a timetable.
routes.hearing_line: The defence asks the court to record outstanding disclosure and set a timetable; position remains provisional until source material is served.
routes.safety_note: Disclosure pressure is not a merits win — needs solicitor review before plea or trial strategy is fixed.

routes.title: Mitigation / damage-limitation fallback
why_it_helps: Keeps a fallback route open if fight routes stay conditional on missing material.

what_hurts_us: Early mitigation signals weakness before disclosure chase completes.
Bad facts on the file limit realistic reduction outcomes.

routes.hearing_line: The defence preserves position on merits while recording that strategy remains provisional pending served material — do not overstate.
